app.podtitul: Verified questions. In Czech and English.

chyba.text: We couldn't load the questions. Check your internet connection and try again.

uvod.mujJazykText: Which language should we use? You can change it any time in Settings.
uvod.jakHrat: How do you want to play?
uvod.jakHratText: Every question is in Czech and English – choose how you want to see them.

zpusobPopis.obe: Questions {jazyk}, always with a translation {druhy} below.

uvod.lzeZmenit: You can change this any time in Settings.

domu.serieDniTitulek: How many days in a row you have finished at least one round
domu.bezUkladani: This browser doesn't allow saving – your progress will be lost when you close the page.

obtiznost.vyber: Choose a difficulty. A round has up to 10 questions.

hra.opustitText: A round you don't finish won't count.

rada-5.popis: Answer 5 in a row correctly in one round.

rada-10.popis: Answer 10 in a row correctly in one round.

temata-3.popis: Complete 3 topics (every difficulty with at least ★).

tema-hvezdy.popis: Get every star in one topic.

kategorie-hvezdy.popis: Get every star in a whole category.

polyglot.popis: Finish a round with questions in a language other than yours.

bez-napovedy.popis: Get ★★ or more in a foreign-language round with translation on tap – without opening it once.

nastaveni.prekladNapoveda: The translation appears for the question, the answers and the explanation.
nastaveni.oHreOtazky: Every question has been fact-checked and comes with a short explanation.
nastaveni.oHreSoukromi: Your progress is stored only on this device. We don't track anything – no accounts, no ads.
nastaveni.smazatText: All stars, badges and day streaks will be deleted. Your language settings stay. This can't be undone.
